vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: moltbot-best-practices
Version: 1.1.3

The skill bundle consists entirely of documentation and configuration advice aimed at improving the behavior and reliability of AI agents. The `SKILL.md` file, treated as a prompt injection surface, contains instructions for the agent to be more transparent, confirm actions, seek approval, and stop when commanded, all of which are security-enhancing behaviors. The recommended configuration changes are for improving agent memory and context handling, not for malicious purposes. There is no executable code, data exfiltration, or any other indicators of malicious intent or significant vulnerabilities.
